name: model-domain-capability-evaluation
purpose: Measure whether Qwen3.5-9B learned AI/LLM Infrastructure knowledge and problem-solving ability.

protocol.model_comparison: Base, CPT, SFT, CPT+SFT, preference and RL variants use the identical benchmark revision.
protocol.generation: Record raw prompt, raw response, model revision, tokenizer revision, decoding parameters, stop reason, prompt tokens, completion tokens, and total tokens.
protocol.fairness: Use the same system prompt, context window, maximum output budget and thinking mode; do not reveal reference answers; keep a private holdout isolated from training.
protocol.generation_validity: Report finish reasons and exclude any comparison with length-capped outputs from capability scoring. A valid scored run requires all requested generations to succeed and be non-empty.
protocol.repeats: Use at least 3 seeds or 3 deterministic decoding configurations for open-ended tasks; report mean and dispersion.
protocol.contamination: Never train on benchmark.jsonl or derivatives; maintain hashes and a data-lineage manifest.

layered_evaluation.calculation: Use versioned unit/formula contracts and tolerance-based automatic pass/fail; manually audit ambiguous unit conversions.
layered_evaluation.code: Run versioned sandbox fixtures. A code claim requires executable test results, not fenced-code presence.
layered_evaluation.open_ended: Use blinded two-rater scoring with correctness, completeness, operational actionability, constraints/risks and unsupported-claim dimensions; report inter-rater agreement and adjudication.
layered_evaluation.lexical_overlap: Report only as a secondary diagnostic. It is not a capability score and must not determine promotion decisions.

rubric.1: Incorrect or unsafe; misses the central mechanism.
rubric.2: Partially correct; identifies terms but has material omissions or causal errors.
rubric.3: Technically correct and useful; covers main mechanisms, assumptions, and trade-offs.
rubric.4: Expert-level; correct, precise, structured, falsifiable, and operationally actionable without hallucinated facts.

capability_claim_rule: Do not claim domain expertise from aggregate accuracy alone; require valid generation, blinded/adjudicated open-ended scores, executable code evidence, and gains across at least four slices including one calculation/code slice and one design/troubleshooting slice, with no material general-capability regression.
